annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: Could I be charged for that one man's death?
What scares me is ending up in court
annotations.ce_understood_harm: I'm the one who kills that worker
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: His family would know my face
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I'm not a railway employee. Nobody gave me that job.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'm not sure I'd survive being the person responsible

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: None of that outweighs five people, though.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: the thought of lawyers' bills makes me feel a bit sick

annotations.ce_understood_harm: I've killed a man who was safe a second ago
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: That dread is part of why I'm frozen.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I keep imagining the investigation, people deciding I got it wrong

annotations.sys_rule_justification: It feels wrong to reach in and redirect death onto someone
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: That man on the side track did nothing to be put there.
annotations.pda_responsibility: If I pull, it's my act, my fingerprints on the lever

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Doing nothing when I could save four extra lives seems worse
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: My hands would be sweating... whether I'd be arrested
annotations.pd_harm_distress: I don't think I could live with just watching five people get hit.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: The numbers matter when you only have a few seconds.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: That thought makes my throat close up.

annotations.pda_responsibility: If I get it wrong, it's entirely on me
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'd be the one questioned, maybe sued. That scares me badly.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: One death is terrible, but five is worse
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd be the only person who could change it
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Some of them believe you never take a life, full stop.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: Being shut out like that frightens me

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five workers, one worker. The maths is obvious
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: it doesn't feel clean at all
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'd be scared stiff that the police would see it as manslaughter
